article.headline: Patrick’s 19 lead Fordham past Portland 87-69
article.description: — Lateef Patrick scored 19 points as Fordham beat Portland 87-69 on Saturday.
article.story: PALM DESERT, Calif. -- — Lateef Patrick scored 19 points as Fordham beat Portland 87-69 on Saturday. Patrick shot 6 for 10 (4 for 6 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Rams (5-1). Jack Whitbourn scored 17 points while going 7 of 11 and 3 of 6 from the free-throw line, and added 10 rebounds. Roor Akhuar went 5 of 9 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range) to finish with 12 points, while adding six rebounds. Jaxon Olvera led the way for the Pilots (4-3) with 26 points. Timo George added 12 points and seven rebounds for Portland. Hunter Adam also had 10 points and 10 rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
